methodSections.heading: Hazelnut Rice Noodles
steps: Toast the nuts in a frypan over a medium heat
Grind the nuts into a crumble and then soak over-night in just enough water to moisten them.
Add the nuts, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, chilli to a food processor and slowly add the oil while processing.
Thin the mixture with a touch of water to taste.
Soak the rice noodle in hot water until soft, heat sauce with the kale and pour over noodles. Garnish with cress, toasted nuts and chilli.
